description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon Connect Customer Profiles service within the AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for various API operations and extends a generic AWS client class.

classes.name: CustomerProfilesClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Connect Customer Profiles service, providing methods corresponding to different API operations.

methods.name: addProfileKey
methods.description: Adds a profile key to an existing customer profile.

methods.name: batchGetCalculatedAttributeForProfile
methods.description: Retrieves calculated attributes for multiple profiles in batch.

methods.name: createDomain
methods.description: Creates a new domain for customer profiles.
